title: 护理推送助手 · 宣武神经外科演示

scenes.cn: 大家好。这是护理推送助手，宣武医院神经外科的演示版。我们把住院健康教育，做成可以交接、可以质控的护理作业，而不是再做一个内容网站。
scenes.en: This is the Nursing Push Assistant, a Xuanwu neurosurgery demo. Inpatient education becomes a handoff-ready, auditable nursing workflow—not another content site.

scenes.cn: 医护从登录页进入作业台。测试期不发送真实验证码，选择护士长，点进入作业台即可。现场讲解时，也可以用顶部演示条切换身份。
scenes.en: Clinicians enter from this login page. The demo sends no real SMS code. Choose Head Nurse and continue. During a live talk, the top demo bar can switch roles.

scenes.cn: 进来以后，护士站主界面是床位图。八张床能看到患者、护理等级和标记色点。责任护士只能操作自己分管的床，这是和全科宣教工具的分界。
scenes.en: The nurse station opens on a bed map. Eight beds show the patient, nursing level, and tag colors. Primary nurses act only on assigned beds—the line versus a ward-wide education tool.

scenes.cn: 打开一床。点套用普通入院路径，就会生成两篇待学习：入院须知，和防跌倒宣教。右侧是床头码，和患者链接是同一条。档案里还能维护诊断、手术日和责任床。
scenes.en: Open bed one. Apply the admission pathway to create two tasks: admission notes and fall prevention. The QR on the right is the same patient link. The chart still holds diagnosis, surgery date, and assignment.

scenes.cn: 患者用微信扫床头码，或在电脑上打开同一条链接。先阅读健康教育知情提示。同意之后，才进入宣教内容。
scenes.en: The patient scans the bedside code, or opens the same link on a computer. They read the education consent notice first, then enter the materials.

scenes.cn: 待学习里出现两篇。请把入院须知读满大约八秒，系统才记为有效阅读。防跌倒这篇请故意不读，用来留下一个护理缺口。
scenes.en: Two items appear in the inbox. Stay on admission notes for about eight seconds to count as effective reading. Leave fall prevention unread, so a nursing gap remains.

scenes.cn: 打开入院须知后，顶部会提示还要停留几秒。停满阈值，护士站就把这篇记成已读。中途退出、时间不够，仍然算未读。
scenes.en: A timer at the top counts remaining seconds. When the threshold is met, the nurse station marks it read. Leaving early still counts as unread.

scenes.cn: 没读完的内容，进入今日任务的当面补讲。护士到床旁讲完，点已当面完成，这条作业就闭环了。推了但没人看，不再是一个没人接的缺口。
scenes.en: Unread items enter today’s bedside teaching list. After a face-to-face talk, tap completed, and the loop is closed. Pushed-but-unread is no longer an unowned gap.

scenes.cn: 需要精准推送时，先选图文，再按标记组圈人。比如只把糖尿病饮食，发给打了这个标记的患者，而不必全科群发。责任护士默认也只能推自己的床。
scenes.en: For targeted teaching, pick an article, then filter by tag group. Send diabetes diet only to tagged patients, not the whole ward. Primary nurses default to their own beds.

scenes.cn: 智能计划一次设定，长期有效。把高危跌倒的患者圈进来，锚点选首次扫码，当天就会自动收到防跌倒宣教，护士不必每人点一次发送。
scenes.en: Plans are set once and stay on. Tag high fall-risk patients, anchor on first scan, and fall prevention is delivered that day—no per-patient send.

scenes.cn: 最后看护理部看板。今日新增、有效阅读、未读人数会对上刚才的操作。下面还有入院包二十四小时完成率，方便交班和质控把成果带走。
scenes.en: Finally the nursing board. New enrollments, effective reads, and unread counts match what we just did. Twenty-four-hour pathway completion supports handover and quality control.

scenes.cn: 这一版跑通的是作业闭环。微信小程序、医院信息系统和咨询问答，不在本演示里。感谢观看。
scenes.en: This build proves the work loop. WeChat mini program, HIS, and consult Q and A are out of scope here. Thank you.
